    <h2><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao/p/21385620" title="发布于 2026-08-22 06:18">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">知识库文件解析失败：一次由 Domain Index 引发的定位记录</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-08-22 06:19">2026-08-22 06:18</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">47</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(21385620);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F21385620&amp;targetId=21385620&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>知识库上传文件后，解析流程不一定失败在文件本身。有时日志只暴露出“保存分块失败”，真正的问题却在数据库对象状态上。笔者环境中，这次问题最终定位到 Oracle 表上的 Domain Index 处于 failed 状态。</p>
<h2 id="01--先用小文件复现问题">01 | 先用小文件复现问题</h2>
<p>为了快速验证，笔者先用一个小文件复现。上传后，解析任务能被 Worker 接收，但写入分块时报错：</p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">2026-07-12 07:34:31: Worker received task, preparing to parse
2026-07-12 07:36:33: Error saving chunks to database: Oracle batch insert text chunks failed
</code></pre>
<p>这个日志说明：文件解析流程已经进入后台任务，但在保存 chunks 到数据库时失败。因此排查重点可以先放在目标表、索引和批量写入相关对象上。</p>
<h2 id="02--检查目标表上的-domain-index">02 | 检查目标表上的 Domain Index</h2>
<p>问题最终定位为：<code>AI_PLATFORM.KBOT_BIZ_TXT_EMBEDDING</code> 表上存在 failed 的 Domain Index。</p>
<p>用于检查 Domain Index 状态的 SQL 如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">SELECT i.owner,
 i.index_name,
 c.column_name,
 i.index_type,
 i.status,
 i.domidx_status,
 i.domidx_opstatus
 FROM dba_indexes i
 LEFT JOIN dba_ind_columns c
 ON c.index_owner = i.owner
 AND c.index_name = i.index_name
 WHERE i.table_owner = 'AI_PLATFORM'
 AND i.table_name = 'KBOT_BIZ_TXT_EMBEDDING'
 AND i.index_type = 'DOMAIN'
 ORDER BY i.index_name, c.column_position;
</code></pre>
<p>为了保留现场，也可以先导出相关索引创建语句：</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">SET LONG 1000000
SET LONGCHUNKSIZE 1000000
SET PAGESIZE 0
SET LINESIZE 32767
SET TRIMSPOOL ON

SPOOL /tmp/kbot_text_indexes.sql

SELECT DBMS_METADATA.GET_DDL('INDEX', 'IDX_FULLSEARCH_TXT_HEADER', 'AI_PLATFORM')
FROM dual;

SELECT DBMS_METADATA.GET_DDL('INDEX', 'IDX_FULLSEARCH_TXT_EMBEDDING', 'AI_PLATFORM')
FROM dual;

SPOOL OFF
</code></pre>
<p>其中一个索引创建语句如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">CREATE INDEX "AI_PLATFORM"."IDX_FULLSEARCH_TXT_EMBEDDING"
ON "AI_PLATFORM"."KBOT_BIZ_TXT_EMBEDDING" ("CONTENT")
INDEXTYPE IS "CTXSYS"."CONTEXT"
PARAMETERS ('lexer chinese_lexer')
</code></pre>
<p>本次处理时，先删除处于 failed 状态的异常索引：</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">DROP INDEX AI_PLATFORM.IDX_FULLSEARCH_TXT_EMBEDDING FORCE;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="03--修复后重新验证">03 | 修复后重新验证</h2>
<p>处理完相关索引后，再次检查状态，Domain Index 已恢复正常：</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">OWNER INDEX_NAME COLUMN_NAME INDEX_TYPE STATUS DOMIDX_STATUS DOMIDX_OPSTATUS
AI_PLATFORM IDX_FULLSEARCH_TXT_EMBEDDING CONTENT DOMAIN VALID VALID VALID

OWNER INDEX_NAME COLUMN_NAME INDEX_TYPE STATUS DOMIDX_STATUS DOMIDX_OPSTATUS
AI_PLATFORM IDX_FULLSEARCH_TXT_HEADER HEADER DOMAIN VALID VALID VALID

OWNER INDEX_NAME COLUMN_NAME INDEX_TYPE STATUS DOMIDX_STATUS DOMIDX_OPSTATUS
AI_PLATFORM IDX_FULLSEARCH_TXT_SEARCH_HELPER SEARCH_HELPER DOMAIN VALID VALID VALID
</code></pre>
<p>随后上传同一个文件，解析成功：</p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">2026-07-12 08:15:31: Worker received task, preparing to parse
2026-07-12 08:17:47: Successfully saved 1 chunks with embeddings
</code></pre>
<p>这次排查的关键点是：当知识库文件解析报出 <code>Oracle batch insert text chunks failed</code> 时，不要只看文件内容或解析程序，也要检查写入表上的 Domain Index 状态。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202607/635610-20260712174811122-1984939206.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
